messages:
julia: quick heads-up — noticed a discrepancy between console preview "effective_count" and rollout telemetry after the config schema migration
julia: preview card for change c-210 shows 1,870 affected in cohort=canary but rollout events tagged rollout=preview show 1,123
tom: can you share the preview query you used? i want to run it against staging evaluator\julia: called GET /api/v1/configs/preview?change=c-210&cohort=canary&seed=42. preview returned {"effective_count": 1870} (client-eval)
hema: runtime team flipped the bucket salt and bumped evaluator -> v3 last night. browser SDK still ships the old salt baked into the build
noah: that explains it. two options: (A) make the console get a canonical salt from server at runtime and run client-eval with that; (B) provide a lightweight server-side "hash-count" endpoint to compute counts cheaply\julia: preference for (B) — keep client snappy and avoid shipping crypto/hashing shims in the UI when possible
hema: proposed API: GET /api/v2/configs/hash-count?change=c-210&cohort=canary&seed=42&sample=5000 returns ndjson: first line = metadata {"salt":"s-2026-07","evaluator":"v3"}, second line = {
